visual_goal: Show two separate inventory stores feeding one offer kernel, which serves stale-but-bounded read models for search and an exact commit point at checkout.
prompt: A left-to-right landscape diagram. On the left, two separate storage cylinders stacked vertically with clear space between them: the upper blue one labeled 'Tally', with a tiny blank multi-storey building drawn beside it; the lower teal one labeled 'Almanac', with a tiny blank cottage drawn beside it. The building and cottage carry no text at all. In the center, one large gear-shaped engine labeled 'Offer kernel'. One arrow from 'Tally' into 'Offer kernel' and one arrow from 'Almanac' into 'Offer kernel'. Below the kernel, an orange tag-shaped box labeled 'Promotions' with one arrow up into 'Offer kernel'. On the right, two destinations: upper right a shelf of blank cards labeled 'Search read models', reached by one arrow from the kernel labeled 'bounded staleness'; lower right a sturdy gate with a padlock labeled 'Commit point', reached by one arrow from the kernel labeled 'price check'. Exactly five arrows and exactly seven text labels in the whole image.
alt: Two stores, Tally for hotels and Almanac for homes, feed one offer kernel together with promotions; the kernel serves search read models with bounded staleness and a commit point through a price check.
